content.title: Patrick Wilson Joins HBO's Hit Sci-Fi Horror Series in Major Season 3 Role
content.text: Image via Faye's Vision/Cover Images Published Mar 16, 2026, 3:28 PM EDT Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios, House of the Dragon, and Planet of the Apes. He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday, The Penguin, Star Wars: Skeleton Crew, and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news. He has completed a set visit for The Chosen and even has several months of experience writing Gaming Features at ScreenRant. You can find him on X, LinkedIn, and Muckrack. Sign in to your Collider account Video game adaptations have been largely hit or miss over the years, especially when creatives are afraid to lean into the source material. One project within the last few years that may just be the greatest video game adaptation of all time is The Last of Us, which aired its first season back in 2023. The Last of Us Season 1 adapts the first game in its entirety, but Season 2, which aired last year, adapted only the first half of The Last of Us Part II, focused on Ellie (Bella Ramsey). The upcoming third season will adapt the second half of The Last of Us Part II, which takes place at the same time as the first half, but follows Abby (Kaitlyn Dever). When Does ‘The Last of Us’ Season 3 Come Out? Check out the first two seasons of The Last of Us on HBO Max and stay tuned to Collider for more updates and coverage of Season 3. Release Date January 15, 2023 Network HBO Showrunner Craig Mazin After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.
